name: o2_moody_queued_faint
purpose: Moody with a queued faint (decision 0083 section 7): at step 5 Perish Song's perish0 knocks out Scovillain, p2b, and Politoed in the residual; Scovillain's Moody runs after it in the same residual and draws its two stats (MOODY, MOODY): Pokemon.faint() only sets hp 0 and the handler loop skips only a fainted holder (sim/battle.ts:512-514). The engine skipped the handler of a holder at 0 HP. A battle of the doubles differential campaign of decision 0083 section 7 (tools/reference/diff_driver.py random, seed 90, two Reg M-C teams, its battle 17), cut after its step 5: adopted as the regression fixture of that fix. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
